objective: Bring Morbent's Bane to Sven in Duskwood.

description: Here is the weapon against the fiend of which you spoke.  You're all ready, <name>.  Best of luck to you, and I look forward to your tale of glory!
progress: Hello, <name>. You haven't been gone that long, but I see a fire in your eyes I did not see before.
completion: Ah, this will be proof against the fiend Morbent Fel! Well done!
You are ready. Morbent Fel will fall.
